```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Load Libraries
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(clustree)
```

Load in Data from Geo
```{r}
#untar data from GEO
untar("GSE155224_RAW.tar", exdir = "data")

#delete all the CITE files from the data folder
file.remove(list.files("data", pattern = "CITE", full.names = TRUE))

#unzip the cell ranger files
for (f in list.files("data", pattern = "cellranger\\.tar\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)) {
  untar(f, exdir = file.path("data/unzipped", sub("\\.tar.*$", "", basename(f))))
}
```

Get Files and Sample Names
```{r}
files = list.files("data/unzipped", pattern = "filtered_feature_bc_matrix$", full = TRUE)
samples = sapply(strsplit(files, split = ""),function(x)x[3])
```

Load in Data
```{r}
for(i in 1:length(samples)){
 sample = samples[i]
 file = files[i]
 print(sample)
 td = Read10X(file)
 t = CreateSeuratObject(counts = td, project=sample)
 if(sample == samples[1]){
 obj = t
 }else{
 obj = merge(obj, t)
 }
}
```

Set up Patient Cohorts
```{r}
obj@meta.data$cohort = "COVID-19"
obj@meta.data$cohort[nchar(obj@meta.data$orig.ident) == 10] = "Healthy"
```
